newsitem.title: JAPAN: Joyo Bank to issue new shares.
newsitem.headline: Joyo Bank to issue new shares.

text.p: Joyo Bank Ltd said on Monday that it had decided to issue 32.2 billion yen worth of new shares to its shareholders in December as part of efforts to boost its capital adequacy ratio.
By issuing 80.4 million new shares, the bank's capital adequacy ratio will rise from 10.38 percent as the end of March 1996 to 10.97 percent, a company statement said.
The new shares will be offered at 400 yen, midway between the face value of 50 yen and the market price. On the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Monday the share rose eight yen to close at 798.
